items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: that organ that Miss Conley used to play

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you. I know that you talked about the influence of church and that your mom had hoped that you might play organ. So can we talk about your church background? Did that have any effect on your musical sensibilities at all? And maybe if you could reveal the denomination of your church?

Yeah. We were Baptist background. My mother used to sing in the choir. Not the particular time when I was going to church, but when she met my father, that’s what she was doing. Yes, the thing that enthralled me was that organ that Miss Conley used to play. The sermon, what he was saying, went in one ear and went out the other. I couldn’t wait for time to go home. But when she started to play that organ – and she’d always start with a drone. Finishing up – when he’s finishing up what he’s doing, and before – I’ve…
So it is in the foundation of your music.
